source: Waiter?
target: 服务员？

source: &557 You wonder if this counts as a corpse. Being a machine, he wasn't technically alive to begin with.
target: &557 你不确定，这能不能算尸体。毕竟是机器，严格说，一开始也没活过。

source: &558 A chiller lined with wine bottles stands by the window.
target: &558 窗边的冷藏柜里，摆满了葡萄酒瓶。

source: &559 The cabinet is locked, likely to prevent guests simply helping themselves.
target: &559 柜子锁着，大概是为了不让客人随便自取。

source: &561 The bottles in the cooler are no more than a mess of glass shards and spilled liquor.
target: &561 冷藏柜里的酒瓶，如今只剩碎玻璃和洒出来的酒。

source: &702 Though obscured by his dark glasses, you can tell that the guard is staring right through you. Apparently, conversation is not his priority.
target: &702 虽然他戴着墨镜，但你知道，守卫正盯着你。看来，他并不打算聊天。

source: &703 While this synth is no doubt carrying a splittable personality, deactivating a guard where all can see may alarm the other guests.
target: &703 这个合成人无疑有可以分离的人格，可当着所有人的面停用守卫，可能会惊动其他宾客。

source: &578 It might be presumptuous to be the first to sit down for dinner.
target: &578 第一个坐下来等开饭，也许显得有些冒失。

source: &583 You're unsure if you could actually move the table. The fact that you managed to tip it was likely the work of adrenaline.
target: &583 你不确定，自己究竟能不能挪动这张桌子。刚才能把它掀翻，多半是肾上腺素起了作用。

source: &602 It looks like the waiters are in the process of setting up aperitifs.
target: &602 看来，服务员正在准备开胃酒。

source: &2012 This isn't the first time a table's saved my life.
target: &2012 桌子救我的命，已经不是第一次了。

source: &2013 Nothing on it I can use, and I'm not exactly equipped to repair synthetics.
target: &2013 上面没东西能用，我也没带修合成人的设备。

source: &2014 It's too badly damaged to get anything useful out of it.
target: &2014 损坏得太严重了，提不出有用的东西。

source: &603 The guards' uniform appearance serves to heighten their intimidating nature.
target: &603 守卫的外貌整齐划一，让他们显得更加吓人。

source: &658 You can't find anything on her body that isn't an item of fashion.
target: &658 她身上除了时尚用品，你找不到别的东西。

source: &659 The blast has apparently spared her expensively-engineered beauty, though not her life. You wonder if this detail might have been of some comfort to her.
target: &659 爆炸夺走了她的命，却没有破坏她花大价钱改造出的美貌。不知道，这一点是否能给她些许安慰。

source: &660 You swab the paper across a wound, taking a sample of her blood.
target: &660 你用纸巾擦过伤口，取下一份血液样本。
